description.zh: 分支 ID，用于唯一标识一个 Supabase 分支。
description.en: The branch ID that uniquely identifies a Supabase branch.

description.zh: 客户端幂等令牌，用于保证重试请求的幂等性。
description.en: The client idempotency token that ensures the idempotence of retry requests.

description.zh: 备份分支名称。指定后恢复前自动创建备份分支。
description.en: The backup branch name. If specified, automatic creation of a backup branch is performed before recovery.

description.zh: 主分支对应的 Supabase 项目 ID。
description.en: The Supabase project ID associated with the primary branch.

description.zh: 地域 ID。创建主分支时必须指定，创建子分支时默认继承主分支所在地域。
description.en: The region ID. This parameter is required when you create a primary branch. When you create a sub-branch, the region is inherited from the primary branch by default.
The ID of the source branch from which to recover.
The LSN of the source branch to recover to.

description.zh: 恢复来源分支的时间点，需在可恢复窗口内。
description.en: The point in time of the source branch to recover to. The value must be within the recoverable time window.

descriptions.zh: 该接口用于将目标分支恢复到来源分支的指定时间点或 LSN。恢复前可指定备份分支名称以保留原目标分支。
descriptions.en: Recovers a target branch to a specified point in time or LSN of the source branch. Before recovery, you can specify a backup branch name to preserve the original target branch.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb restore-branch --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --project-id spb-xxxx --branch-id br-xxxx --source-branch-id br-main --source-branch-timestamp 2026-04-08T09:11:12Z --source-branch-lsn 0/3522648 --preserve-under-name backup-main --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000 --region cn-hangzhou
